plan: Given my value of $25, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to avoid overpaying. Expecting Betty and Charles to bid near their values, I will bid $24.9. Bidding $15 should be competitive, allowing a win if others bid conservatively, while limiting loss if bids are higher.

Assuming Andy and Betty bid close to their values, I should bid slightly above the midpoint of possible values to increase winning chances without overpaying.
